# =============================================================================
# Portainer LXC - Container Management UI
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 100
# Container IP: 10.100.1.100 (container network)
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Central management UI for all Docker containers across the homelab.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 100
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "portainer" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "portainer"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - no LAN access needed)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.core.portainer}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 512

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Privileged for Docker
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Portainer"
  service_description = "Central Docker container management UI with Watchtower auto-updates"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://portainer.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.core.portainer}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Portainer", port = 9000, info = "Container management UI" },
    { name = "Edge Agent Tunnel", port = 8000, info = "Edge agent communication" },
    { name = "Watchtower", port = 0, info = "Automatic container updates (daily)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f portainer
cd /config && docker compose logs -f watchtower
```

**Manual Watchtower run:**
```
docker exec watchtower /watchtower --run-once
```

## Agents

All app LXCs run Portainer Agent on port 9001 for centralized management.

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=portainer` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["portainer", "management", "watchtower"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "portainer_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "portainer"
  backend_url = "http://${module.portainer.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "portainer.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.portainer]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.portainer.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.portainer.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.portainer.ssh_command
}

  value = {
    internal = module.portainer_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.portainer.ip_address}:9000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.portainer_route.remote_config_path
}

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer CE - Container Management UI
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    container_name: portainer
    command: -H unix:///var/run/docker.sock

      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Watchtower - Automatic Container Updates
  # ==========================================================================
  watchtower:
    image: containrrr/watchtower:latest
    container_name: watchtower
    environment:
      - WATCHTOWER_CLEANUP=true
      - WATCHTOWER_POLL_INTERVAL=86400  # Check daily
      - WATCHTOWER_INCLUDE_RESTARTING=true
      - WATCHTOWER_LABEL_ENABLE=true    # Only update containers with label
      - DOCKER_API_VERSION=1.52         # Match Docker daemon API version
      - TZ=America/New_York
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    restart: unless-stopped

# Traefik - Reverse Proxy & Ingress Controller
# https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/

name: traefik

services:
  traefik:
    container_name: traefik
    image: traefik:v3.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"        # HTTP
      - "443:443"      # HTTPS
      - "8082:8082"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
      - CF_API_EMAIL=${CF_API_EMAIL}
    volumes:
      # Static config (synced by docker-host module to /config/static/)
      - /config/static/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      # Dynamic configs (synced by docker-host module to /config/dynamic/)
      - /config/dynamic:/config/dynamic:ro
      # Certificates (Docker volume for persistence across restarts)
      - certs:/config/certs
      # Logs (Docker volume)
      - logs:/config/logs
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "traefik", "healthcheck", "--ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Portainer Agent for remote management
  portainer-agent:
    container_name: portainer_agent
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    ports:
      - 9001:9001
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  certs:
  logs:

        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&

        import requests

    labels:

    restart: unless-stopped

  # OpenWebUI - AI Chat Interface
  # ==========================================================================
  openwebui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    container_name: openwebui

      - 8.8.8.8
      - 1.1.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Ollama - Local LLM Backend

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # GPU passthrough disabled - add back later when GPU is configured:
    # group_add:
    #   - "109"  # render group for GPU access
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:latest
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:latest
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:

# Obsidian LiveSync - CouchDB Server
# https://github.com/vrtmrz/obsidian-livesync

name: obsidian-sync

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # CouchDB - Obsidian LiveSync Backend
  # ==========================================================================
  couchdb:
    image: couchdb:3.3.3
    container_name: obsidian-livesync
    environment:
      - COUCHDB_USER=${COUCHDB_USER}
      - COUCHDB_PASSWORD=${COUCHDB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - couchdb-data:/opt/couchdb/data
      # Mount directory (not file) - CouchDB needs to write docker.ini here
      - ./couchdb-config:/opt/couchdb/etc/local.d
    ports:
      - "5984:5984"
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:5984/_up"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Agent - Container Management
  # ==========================================================================
  portainer-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:latest
    container_name: portainer-agent
    ports:
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  couchdb-data:

### 2. PORTAINER AGENT vs EDGE AGENT - KEY DIFFERENCES

**Standard Portainer Agent (Current Setup - Port 9001):**
- Runs as a container in each Docker environment
- Requires inbound connectivity from Portainer manager to agent
- Portainer connects: 10.100.1.100:9000 -> 10.100.x.x:9001 (TCP)
- Works within internal container network
- No firewall traversal capability
- Simpler deployment model

**Portainer Edge Agent (Not Currently Used - Port 8000 listener on manager):**
- Agent initiates outbound connection to manager (reverse connection)
- Portainer manager listens on port 8000 for edge agent tunnel connections
- Can operate across NAT/firewalls without inbound access
- Supports persistent tunneling and edge computing scenarios
- Requires AGENT_URL to be set for the agent to know where to connect
- More resilient to network changes
- Better for remote/edge locations

**Your Current Setup:** Port 8000 is listening on the Portainer container but no agents are configured to use it - all agents use the standard port 9001 model.

---

### 3. ENVIRONMENT CONNECTION ARCHITECTURE

**Current Connection Flow:**

```
Portainer Manager (LXC 100)
├─ Port 9000: Web UI (HTTPS via Traefik)
├─ Port 8000: Edge Agent Tunnel Listener (unused)
│
└─ Internal Network Connections (container network 10.100.0.0/16)
   ├─ 10.100.2.200:9001 (Traefik Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.2.201:9001 (Dashboards Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.2.202:9001 (Authelia Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.3.104:9001 (Immich Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.4.101:9001 (Jellyfin Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.4.102:9001 (Media Management Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.5.100:9001 (Monitoring Agent)
   ├─ 10.100.5.101:9001 (OpenWebUI Agent)
   └─ 10.100.5.103:9001 (Obsidian Sync Agent)
```

**Docker Socket Access:**
- Each agent mounts `/var/run/docker.sock` for Docker daemon access
- Each agent mounts `/var/lib/docker/volumes` for volume management
- Agents use `portainer/agent:latest` image (auto-updates via Watchtower)

---

### 4. SECURITY CONCERNS AROUND PORT 9001 EXPOSURE

**Current Risk Assessment:**

| Concern | Status | Severity | Details |
|---------|--------|----------|---------|
| Direct port 9001 exposure to LAN | LOW | Medium | Agents only listen on container network (10.100.x.x), not exposed to home LAN (192.168.1.x) |
| Unencrypted agent communication | MEDIUM | High | Agent-to-manager uses plain TCP/HTTP, no TLS/authentication |
| Docker socket access | CRITICAL | Critical | Each agent has full access to Docker daemon via socket - equivalent to root |
| Volume mount access | CRITICAL | Critical | Agents can access all Docker volumes, including sensitive data |
| Default agent credentials | LOW | Low | Agents connect to manager on internal network, no password required |
| No network policies | MEDIUM | Medium | No Kubernetes-style network policies limiting agent access |

**Why Port 9001 is Generally Safe in Your Setup:**
1. Only accessible within internal container network (10.100.0.0/16)
2. No exposure to home LAN (192.168.1.x)
3. No internet exposure (behind Traefik which is not publicly accessible on 9001)
4. Network isolated from external access

**Critical Risk if Exposed:**
- If port 9001 were exposed to LAN or internet, attackers could:
  - Take full control of container environments
  - Access all container data and volumes
  - Potentially escape to host system
  - Manipulate all running services

---

### 5. CHANGES NEEDED FOR EDGE AGENT DEPLOYMENT

**To Switch from Standard to Edge Agents:**

#### A. Agent Configuration Changes:
```yaml
# Current (Standard Agent):
portainer-agent:
  image: portainer/agent:latest
  ports:
    - "9001:9001"  # Inbound connection from manager

# Needed (Edge Agent):
portainer-agent:
  image: portainer/agent:latest
  environment:
    - AGENT_HOST=0.0.0.0
    - AGENT_PORT=9001
    - AGENT_URL=http://portainer.homelab.rambtech.dev:8000  # Manager address
    - AGENT_SECRET=<secure-token>  # Authentication token
  ports:
    - "9001:9001"  # Outbound tunnel to manager
```

#### B. Portainer Manager Configuration:
- The `8000` port listener is already configured (good!)
- Need to set up Edge Agent registrations in Portainer UI
- Configure AGENT_URL environment variable on each agent
- Optionally enable Edge Agent token authentication

#### C. Network Changes Required:
- Agents no longer need to be on internal network exclusively
- Edge agents can reach Portainer on any network with outbound connectivity
- Could move agents to different networks/VLANs
- Remote locations could connect via WireGuard/Tailscale

#### D. IP Registry Updates (Optional):
- Edge agents don't require fixed IPs for connectivity
- Could simplify network design for distributed setups
- N8N could be added without complex networking
